{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|That's not entirely true, Javen. Yes, upgrades are required at authorized service centers, but that particular requirement is mandated by Imperial law. When it comes to the health of its citizens, the Empire is not taking chances. Furthermore, the 2-1B has exceptional skill and flexibility, so upgrades are rarely required.|Bendics|<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>}}
[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Bendics''' was a contributor and commentator on "[[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]." Bendics replied to [[Javen]] over the need for the [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]] to be upgraded at authorized service centers.
